author: codex
root_cause: Installed Solidity Tree-sitter grammar gives a between-branches comment field=body. Original CFG selects the comment as else body and falls back the function. Comments after else may carry field=else.
fix: Ignore only comment children, require exactly one named condition, one body without direct else or exactly two around one direct else. Reject unexplained children, extra/missing bodies and misplaced/duplicate else. Analyze the genuine branch bodies; no HCG mutation or MVP expansion.

ambiguous AST shapes rejected rather than extra bodies ignored
HCG node IDs labels tokenizer values base edges unchanged
